```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false

library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(nflverse)

game_outcomes <- load_schedules(season = 2024)  # Adjust the year if necessary

steelers_games <- game_outcomes %>% filter(home_team == "PIT" | away_team == "PIT")

steelers_games_filtered <- steelers_games %>%
  filter(!is.na(home_score) & !is.na(away_score)) %>%
  mutate(
    points_scored = ifelse(home_team == "PIT", home_score, away_score),
    points_allowed = ifelse(home_team == "PIT", away_score, home_score),
    point_differential = points_scored - points_allowed
  )

total_point_differential <- sum(steelers_games_filtered$point_differential)


```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false

completed_games <- game_outcomes %>%
  filter(!is.na(home_score) & !is.na(away_score))

home_stats <- completed_games %>%
  mutate(
    team = home_team,
    points_scored = home_score,
    points_allowed = away_score,
    win = ifelse(home_score > away_score, 1, 0),
    loss = ifelse(home_score < away_score, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(team, points_scored, points_allowed, win, loss)

away_stats <- completed_games %>%
  mutate(
    team = away_team,
    points_scored = away_score,
    points_allowed = home_score,
    win = ifelse(away_score > home_score, 1, 0),
    loss = ifelse(away_score < home_score, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(team, points_scored, points_allowed, win, loss)

team_stats <- bind_rows(home_stats, away_stats)

team_summary <- team_stats %>%
  group_by(team) %>%
  summarise(
    point_differential = sum(points_scored) - sum(points_allowed),
    wins = sum(win),
    losses = sum(loss)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(point_differential))

team_summary_gt <- team_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "NFL Team Performance Summary",
    subtitle = "Point Differential, Wins, and Losses for the Current Season"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    team = "Team",
    point_differential = "Point Differential",
    wins = "Wins",
    losses = "Losses"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(point_differential, wins, losses),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = point_differential,
    colors = scales::col_numeric(
      palette = c("red", "white", "green"),
      domain = c(min(team_summary$point_differential), max(team_summary$point_differential))
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = "medium",
    table.width = pct(100)
  )

team_summary_gt

```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

team_summary %>%
  mutate(
    win_pct = wins / (wins + losses),
    team_label = team
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = point_differential, y = win_pct)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = team_label), 
                  size = 4, 
                  box.padding = 0.3, 
                  point.padding = 0.3,
                  max.overlaps = 15) +
  labs(
    title = "Winning Percentage vs. Point Differential",
    x = "Point Differential",
    y = "Winning Percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false

initial_rating <- 1500
ratings <- team_summary %>% mutate(rating = initial_rating)

completed_games <- completed_games %>%
  mutate(gameday = as.Date(gameday, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  arrange(week)

unique_weeks <- unique(completed_games$week)

for (w in unique_weeks) {
  weekly_games <- completed_games %>% filter(week == w)
  
  weekly_games_with_ratings <- weekly_games %>%
    left_join(ratings, by = c("home_team" = "team")) %>%
    rename(home_rating = rating) %>%
    left_join(ratings, by = c("away_team" = "team")) %>%
    rename(away_rating = rating) %>%
    mutate(
      home_expected = 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((away_rating - home_rating) / 400)),
      away_expected = 1 - home_expected,
      home_result = ifelse(home_score > away_score, 1, 0),
      away_result = ifelse(away_score > home_score, 1, 0),
      home_rating_change = 20 * (home_result - home_expected),
      away_rating_change = 20 * (away_result - away_expected)
    )
  
  # Update ratings
  ratings <- ratings %>%
    left_join(
      weekly_games_with_ratings %>% group_by(home_team) %>%
        summarise(rating_change = sum(home_rating_change)),
      by = c("team" = "home_team")
    ) %>%
    mutate(rating = rating + coalesce(rating_change, 0)) %>%
    select(-rating_change) %>%
    left_join(
      weekly_games_with_ratings %>% group_by(away_team) %>%
        summarise(rating_change = sum(away_rating_change)),
      by = c("team" = "away_team")
    ) %>%
    mutate(rating = rating + coalesce(rating_change, 0)) %>%
    select(-rating_change)
}

final_rankings <- ratings %>%
  arrange(desc(rating)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())

final_rankings_gt <- final_rankings %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "NFL Team Rankings Considering Opponent Strength",
    subtitle = "Elo-Style Ratings for Current Season"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    team = "Team",
    rating = "Rating",
    rank = "Rank"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = rating,
    decimals = 1
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  )

final_rankings_gt

```

```{r}
# Merge Elo Ratings with Team Summary to Calculate Winning Percentage
elo_win_df <- final_rankings %>%
  left_join(
    team_summary %>% 
      mutate(win_pct = wins / (wins + losses)),
    by = "team"
  )

# Plot Winning Percentage vs. Elo Rating
elo_win_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rating, y = win_pct)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkgreen", size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "orange", se = FALSE) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = team), 
                  size = 3.5, 
                  box.padding = 0.3, 
                  point.padding = 0.3,
                  max.overlaps = 15) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Winning Percentage vs. Elo Rating",
    x = "Elo Rating",
    y = "Winning Percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false

last_game_date <- max(completed_games$gameday, na.rm = TRUE)

next_steelers_game <- game_outcomes %>%
  filter((home_team == "PIT" | away_team == "PIT") & gameday > last_game_date) %>%
  arrange(gameday) %>%
  slice(1)

if (nrow(next_steelers_game) == 0) {
  "No game scheduled for the next week for the Pittsburgh Steelers."
} else {
  if (next_steelers_game$home_team == "PIT") {
    opponent_team <- next_steelers_game$away_team
  } else {
    opponent_team <- next_steelers_game$home_team
  }

  opponent_rating <- ratings %>%
    filter(team == opponent_team) %>%
    pull(rating)

  steelers_rating <- ratings %>%
    filter(team == "PIT") %>%
    pull(rating)

  steelers_win_probability <- 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((opponent_rating - steelers_rating) / 400))
  
  game_date <- next_steelers_game$gameday

  cat("**Pittsburgh Steelers Next Game:**\n\n")
  cat("Opponent: ", opponent_team, "\n")
  cat("Game Date: ", game_date, "\n")
  cat("Estimated Win Probability (Elo): ", round(steelers_win_probability * 100, 2), "%\n\n")

  # Monte Carlo Simulation
  set.seed(42)
  num_simulations <- 10000
  simulated_outcomes <- replicate(num_simulations, {
    if (runif(1) < steelers_win_probability) {
      return("Win")
    } else {
      return("Loss")
    }
  })
  
  simulated_win_probability <- mean(simulated_outcomes == "Win")

  cat("Monte Carlo Simulated Win Probability: ", round(simulated_win_probability * 100, 2), "%\n")
}


```
